raw:
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE home_team_goal > away_team_goal) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) 
FROM main."Match" m
JOIN main."League" l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE l.name = 'England Premier League' 
  AND m.season = '2015/2016'
  AND m.date BETWEEN '2015-08-01' AND '2016-05-25'
  AND m.date <= '2016-07-01';
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE home_team_goal > away_team_goal) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) 
FROM main."Match" m
JOIN main."League" l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE l.name = 'England Premier League' 
  AND m.season = '2015/2016'
  AND m.date BETWEEN '2015-08-01' AND '2016-05-25'
  AND m.date <= '2016-07-01'
